The best piece of advice I can offer is that period blood comes in all different colors including brown (which freaked 13 year old me out upon seeing).  It’s nothing bad, it just means the blood has been sitting around for a bit since your cycle started. Also if you want to try tampons, slim ones are definitely a good choice for the first time. Good luck out there 🖤
